name: Public procurement of construction works
review_status: Drawn from public statutory sources. Pending review by a Hungarian quantity surveyor before it is relied on for a tender.
references: 322/2015. Korm. rendelet on the procurement of construction works and related services
description: Public construction contracts above the statutory thresholds are awarded through a procurement procedure, and the itemised bill is part of the documentation rather than an internal working paper. That is why the chapter structure is a requirement and not a habit: a tender the client cannot compare line by line against the others is a tender the client cannot lawfully evaluate.
practice_notes: The bill goes out priced at zero for the bidder to complete, and comes back with the same lines in the same order
Adding, merging or renumbering lines on return is the most common formal defect
The contingency line is the client's, not the bidder's, and is not priced by the bidder
